У меня уже есть гайд. Зачем мне Runbook?: I already have a guide. Why would I need Runbook?
Гайд нужно читать, помнить и сверять с и: A guide has to be read, remembered and checked against the game. Runbook goes along with you: it knows which zone you're in and shows what to do now.
Плана под мой класс нет. Что делать?: There's no plan for my class. What do I do?
Планы появляются в каталоге, когда ими д: Plans appear in the catalogue as authors share them. Meanwhile you can build your own: the campaign is already mapped, all that's left is to add your build.
Вышел патч. Runbook будет работать?: A patch is out. Will Runbook work?
After a patch Runbook needs a new build. Until it's out, the program warns you that the game is newer. Once it's out, it updates with one button.
Список не появляется поверх игры: The list doesn't show over the game
Так бывает, когда игра идёт в полноэкран: That happens when the game runs in exclusive fullscreen: it covers Runbook's windows. Switch the game to windowed fullscreen in its settings and the list will appear. If it doesn't, check in Runbook's Settings that the windows over the game are turned on.
